subject: Function-identifier
notes: FUNCTION may be omitted for a function-prototype-name (2002), a function-pointer-name (2014) and a REPOSITORY-declared intrinsic (ALL INTRINSIC or by name), with and without an argument list - including the EMPTY list F() (kb/Work PB969); otherwise FUNCTION is required (COBOL1543). Below 2002 there is no REPOSITORY, so the omission cannot arise.
